name: regex-split-public
objective: Add the missing public split_regex(text, pattern, *, maxsplit=0, flags=0) operation to devtools.core.regex, implemented in the authorized new splitting.py module and exported at the package boundary. Return an immutable tuple preserving Python re.split semantics, including captured groups and unmatched optional captures, Unicode, empty inputs and maxsplit. Preserve existing project compiled-pattern/flags compatibility and regex error behavior; strict annotations must accurately admit None captured-group entries. Existing regex operations must remain unchanged. Investigate actual package conventions and dependencies; do not change tests.
oracle:
import importlib,re,inspect
public=importlib.import_module('devtools.core.regex')
assert hasattr(public,'split_regex'),'Missing public split_regex API'
f=public.split_regex
owner=importlib.import_module('devtools.core.regex.splitting')
assert owner.split_regex is f and 'split_regex' in public.__all__
cases=[('a,b,,c',',',0,0),('xaxbxx','(a)?b',0,0),('AaA','a',0,re.I),('abc','',2,0),('café 雪',r'\s+',0,0),('',',',0,0),('a,b,c',re.compile(','),1,0),('abc',',',-1,0)]
for text,pattern,maximum,flags in cases:
    result=f(text,pattern,maxsplit=maximum,flags=flags)
    assert isinstance(result,tuple)
    assert result==tuple(re.split(pattern,text,maxsplit=maximum,flags=flags))
assert f('xbx','(a)?b')==('x',None,'x')
compiled=re.compile(',',re.I)
assert f('a,b',compiled)==('a','b')
try:f('a,b',compiled,flags=re.I)
except ValueError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('Compiled pattern plus flags must preserve compile_regex contract')
try:f('a','[')
except re.error:pass
else:raise AssertionError('Invalid regex accepted')
signature=inspect.signature(f)
assert signature.parameters['maxsplit'].kind is inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY
assert signature.parameters['flags'].kind is inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY
assert public.search_regex('x','x').value=='x'
print('QWEN_BEHAVIOR_PASSED')
